answer: Weight every attestation by how independently its author has disagreed before: a lone voice on a knoll counts fully, but a cluster that always votes together counts as one voice, however many hulls crowd the jetty. A sybil farm must coordinate its copies to profit, yet that coordination — identical votes and identical timing — leaves a bright trail, like a comet, that collapses its weight. The tenth copy adds nothing, because the ledger discounts agreement itself, not identity.
